result.edit: The failure shows the divider output was 1 when expected to be 0 at cycle 9 with mode=1. The bug occurs because clk_cnt increments by 2 in odd mode (div_o) instead of 1, causing premature count wrap-around. Changing to increment by 1 in both modes preserves the correct timing relationship between count and output generation as specified in the waveform contract.
